rows.note: This is the all-purpose possessive modifier placed before a noun, as in 佢本書 “her book”.

example.english: Her book is pretty good; I'll lend it to you.
example.traditional: 佢本書幾好睇，我借畀你睇吓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 bun2 syu1 gei2 hou2 tai2 ngo5 ze3 bei2 nei5 tai2 haa5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken pronoun for referring to her as an object or subject, without marking gender.

example.english: I saw her at the door.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 hai2 mun4 hau2
